name: Sabri Suby Sell Like Crazy 8-Phase System
description: Complete customer acquisition system based on Sabri Suby's methodology that generated over $400 million in sales across 167 industries
performance_benchmark: $400M+ in client sales, $0 to $10M+ agency growth in 4 years

phase_1_mindset.name: Right Mindset Foundation
phase_1_mindset.description: Establishing proper entrepreneurial mindset for customer acquisition success

components.growth_mindset: Focus on working ON the business, not just IN the business
components.system_thinking: Build automated systems that generate leads and sales 24/7
components.value_first_approach: The person who gives the most value upfront wins
components.metric_driven: Success measured by Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) and Lifetime Value (LTV)

implementation.priority_shift: Spend more time on marketing and selling than just delivering services
implementation.automation_focus: Create systems that work without constant manual intervention
implementation.scalability_preparation: Build foundations that can handle significant growth
implementation.measurement_establishment: Track all key metrics from day one

phase_2_market_research.name: Market Research & Dream Customer Identification
phase_2_market_research.description: Deep customer psychology understanding for precise targeting and messaging

ready_buyers.strategy: Direct sales approach with immediate offers

problem_aware.description: Aware they have a problem but don't know solutions

unaware.description: Unaware they even need your product/service

research_framework.demographic_analysis: Age, gender, income, location, job title
research_framework.behavioral_patterns: Buying habits, content consumption, platform preferences
research_framework.competitive_analysis: What competitors are doing and saying

dream_customer_avatar.detailed_profile: Create specific person with name, background, challenges
dream_customer_avatar.daily_routine: Understand their typical day and touchpoints
dream_customer_avatar.information_sources: Where they get information and make decisions
dream_customer_avatar.buying_triggers: What motivates them to take action
dream_customer_avatar.objections_concerns: What holds them back from purchasing

phase_3_high_value_content_offers.name: High-Value Content Offers (HVCOs)
phase_3_high_value_content_offers.description: Lead magnets that provide immediate value to attract and qualify prospects

appealing_headline.purpose: Grab attention and communicate primary benefit

compelling_subheadline.purpose: Summarize offer details and amplify interest
templates: Step-by-step guide that shows you exactly how to [achieve outcome]
Discover the [adjective] secrets that [target audience] use to [benefit]
Get instant access to the same [resource] that helped [social proof]

benefit_bullet_points.structure: What they'll learn, discover, or gain
templates: ✓ The #1 mistake [target audience] make that [negative consequence]
✓ How to [achieve specific outcome] in just [timeframe]
✓ Why [common belief] is wrong and what to do instead

opt_in_form.privacy_assurance: Clear privacy policy and no-spam promise

hvco_types.checklists: Action items, verification lists, completion guides
hvco_types.tools_calculators: ROI calculators, assessment tools, planning templates

phase_4_godfather_offer.name: The Godfather Offer Creation
phase_4_godfather_offer.description: Irresistible offer that prospects would be missing brain cells to say no to

rationale.purpose: Provide clear explanation why you're making such a generous offer
templates: We're launching a new [service/product] and need case studies
It's our [anniversary/milestone] and we're celebrating by giving back
We have excess capacity this month and want to fill it quickly
We're testing a new system and need beta users to refine it
rationale.implementation: Create logical, believable reason for exceptional value

build_value.purpose: Establish high perceived value before revealing price
techniques: Compare to competitor pricing and show savings
Show ROI or results others have achieved
Reference regular pricing and current discount
build_value.value_stacking: Layer multiple benefits and bonuses to increase total value perception

pricing.purpose: Present aggressive offer with strategic upsells
strategies: Anchor high price then show discounted offer
Bundle complementary services at significant savings
Tiered options with middle option as target
Limited-time pricing with future increase mentioned

payment_options.purpose: Reduce price resistance through flexible payment
options: 3-4 payment installments to lower entry point

premiums.purpose: Free bonuses that increase response alongside main offer
premiums.bonus_positioning: Each bonus should be valued individually and solve related problems

power_guarantee.purpose: Reverse risk from prospect to you

scarcity.purpose: Create urgency through limited availability or time

phase_5_email_marketing.name: Email Marketing & Nurturing System
phase_5_email_marketing.description: Systematic email sequences to warm up prospects and drive conversions

email_success_factors.delivery: Get emails delivered to inbox (not spam)
email_success_factors.open_rates: Compelling subject lines that get opened

welcome_series.email_1: Deliver promised content and set expectations
welcome_series.email_2: Share your story and build connection
welcome_series.email_3: Provide additional value and soft pitch

phase_6_sales_conversion.name: 17-Step Secret Selling System
phase_6_sales_conversion.description: Systematic approach to convert prospects into paying customers

urgency_creation: Price increases scheduled for future date
objection_handling: Address price concerns with value breakdown

phase_7_paid_advertising.name: Paid Advertising & Traffic Generation
phase_7_paid_advertising.description: Profitable advertising strategies with key metrics and optimization

cost_per_lead.calculation: Advertising Cost ÷ Number of Leads Generated
cost_per_lead.optimization: Focus on quality targeting and compelling offers

cost_per_acquisition.calculation: Advertising Cost ÷ Number of New Customers
cost_per_acquisition.importance: Most critical business metric for profitability

lifetime_value.calculation: Average Customer Value × Average Retention Period
lifetime_value.goal: LTV should be 3-5x higher than CPA for profitable scaling

traffic_channels.google_ads: Search and display advertising for high-intent traffic
traffic_channels.facebook_ads: Social targeting with detailed demographic and interest options
traffic_channels.youtube_ads: Video advertising for engagement and brand building
traffic_channels.retargeting: Follow-up advertising to previous website visitors
traffic_channels.seo: Long-term organic traffic through content and optimization

advertising_principles.unit_economics: Every $1 spent should generate $2+ in return
advertising_principles.self_liquidating: Front-end offers pay for advertising costs
advertising_principles.scaling_focus: Once profitable, scale winning campaigns aggressively
advertising_principles.diversification: Never rely on single traffic source

phase_8_optimization_scaling.name: Optimization & Scaling Systems
phase_8_optimization_scaling.description: Systematic approach to optimize and scale profitable customer acquisition

testing_methodology: Test headlines, offers, images, and copy variations
Focus on metrics that matter: conversions, not just clicks
scaling_principles: Scale winning campaigns before they decline
Add new traffic channels once core channels are profitable
Monitor key metrics during scaling to prevent degradation

diversification_strategy.channel_stacking: Layer multiple traffic sources for stability
diversification_strategy.risk_mitigation: Don't rely on single platform or method

hormozi_synergy.value_equation: Complements Hormozi's dream outcome and perceived likelihood
hormozi_synergy.offer_creation: Godfather Offer enhances Hormozi's Grand Slam Offer methodology
hormozi_synergy.market_validation: 97% prospect targeting expands Hormozi's market selection

platform_application.meta_ads: HVCO lead magnets perfect for Facebook/Instagram lead generation
platform_application.linkedin_ads: B2B applications of Godfather Offer for professional services
platform_application.google_ads: Search intent matching with HVCO and Godfather Offers
platform_application.email_marketing: Phase 5 nurture sequences integrate with existing email agents

system_targets.sales_conversion: 10-30% from nurture sequences to Godfather Offer

suby_results.system_effectiveness: Proven across multiple business types and markets

mindset_establishment: Shift focus from working IN business to ON business
Establish value-first approach in all marketing
Set up key metric tracking (CPL, CPA, LTV)
Commit to systematic testing and optimization
market_research_completion: Identify key pain points and desires
hvco_development: Create compelling lead magnets for each awareness level
Design opt-in pages with all key components
Set up delivery systems for immediate value
godfather_offer_creation: Build value stack with multiple components
